en.joke: My therapist told me to touch grass, then immediately sent me a link to her online plant delivery service.
en.explanation: Funny because the therapist's real-world advice is immediately contradicted by her reliance on a convenient digital solution.

people.name: Anna Deavere Smith
people.extract: Anna Deavere Smith is an American actress, playwright, and professor. She is known for her roles as National Security Advisor Dr. Nancy McNally in The West Wing (2000–06), hospital administrator Gloria Akalitus in the Showtime series Nurse Jackie (2009–15), and U.S. District Court Clerk Tina Krissman on the ABC show For the People (2018–19).
highlights: Actress in The West Wing as Dr. Nancy McNally.
Starred as Gloria Akalitus in Nurse Jackie.
Played Tina Krissman in ABC's For the People.

people.name: Giorgos Dimitrakopoulos
people.extract: Giorgos Dimitrakopoulos is a Greek politician who was a Member of the European Parliament for New Democracy; part of the European People's Party.
